headline: Orchasp promoter Satya Shiva Kumar Kanakadandi passes away
summary: Orchasp announced the death of its promoter, Satya Shiva Kumar Kanakadandi, who passed away on October 11, 2026. He held 42,605 equity shares, representing 0.01% of the company's total equity. The company stated that the transmission of his shareholding to his nominee is currently underway. His shares will remain in his name until the transmission process concludes.
whats_next: Share transmission to the nominee upon completion
why_it_matters: Negligible impact on retail investors due to tiny promoter stake.

headline: Orchasp submits AGM scrutinizer's report and voting results
summary: Orchasp Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The submission is a routine regulatory compliance filing made to the stock exchange. Retail investors holding Orchasp shares should note this as standard corporate procedure with no direct impact on stock price or business operations.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on your investment.

headline: Orchasp concludes its annual general meeting for shareholders
hook: Annual general meeting completed by Orchasp
summary: Orchasp Limited has formally submitted the proceedings of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. Such procedural filings are standard regulatory compliance updates for listed entities. This disclosure contains administrative records of the meeting rather than fresh financial guidance or material business catalysts. Retail investors holding the stock should note the completion of routine corporate formalities.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural filing with no immediate impact on stock price
